text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is merged into the main project. Their primary benefit is catching bugs early, which saves significant time and money compared to fixing errors after release. Beyond finding mistakes, reviews are excellent for knowledge sharing. They allow team members to learn new techniques and understand different parts of the codebase, reducing reliance on a single person. Ultimately, this process raises overall team quality by setting consistent standards and encouraging collaboration. A team that reviews code together builds trust and produces more reliable software.
